Name: OpenCode Deck
Author: Ryan Susman
Description: Live state bar for your local OpenCode agents: green=working, amber=idle, red=asking a question, gray=no connected env. Auto-updates as sessions change; press a key to focus that session's terminal.

Actions.Name: Agent State
Actions.Tooltip: One key per OpenCode project. RAG state: green=working, amber=idle, red=asking a question, gray=no env. Press to focus the session's terminal.

Actions.Name: Needs You
Actions.Tooltip: Counts agents blocked on you (red = asking a question).
